title: The Unworthy Storyteller Speaks
lines: Of the many unworthy storytellers who have rolled their mats in the marketplaces of this illustrious land, none is less deserving of your ear than Kai Lung. Yet, since your sublime benevolence has chosen to pause, Kai Lung will unroll his mat.

The story concerns Ling, a young man of impeccable filial piety. His father, on his deathbed, extracted a promise: 'My son, bring honor to our family name. Pass the imperial examinations.' Ling bowed and swore it.

But the examination hall was a den of tigers. The richest candidates bribed the examiners. The most cunning stole answers. Ling, who possessed neither wealth nor cunning, but only diligence and a mother's love, was doomed from the start.

Until a mandarin of mysterious origin took an interest in him. 'You are honest,' said the mandarin. 'That is rarer than genius. I shall help you — and in return, you shall one day help someone else, who shall not know that I helped you.'
And thus the mandarin's network of anonymous kindness spread across the empire, one honest man at a time.
